purpose: Representative broadcast pictures, complete WAV reception, numerical screening followed by PM visual review

policy.tiny_images: Historical failures retained; excluded from this practical qualification. No minimum universally safe size is established.
policy.bit_perfection: Diagnostic only for decoded pictures; exact encoder protocol, waveform, copied audio and silence checks remain.
policy.reference_transmitter: Fresh fldigi TX calibration is no longer a prerequisite under the PM scope decision.
policy.receiver: Pinned Pi fldigi 4.2.13, complete WAV, initial BPSK31, RxID on, AFC off, 5-second polling, settled viewer plus autosave retained.
policy.grampy: Unchanged public auto-mode IQ decoder with accepted default settings. Its production picture support is MFSK64; MFSK32 picture cases explicitly test fldigi compatibility and GramPy text acquisition only.
policy.gate_rationale: Engineering screening limit: raw mean error at most 9.8% of the intensity range, aligned mean at most 7.8%, and channel bias at most 5.9%. Based on useful prior normal-size controls, not a calibrated probabilistic standard. Freeze before new outputs; visual review can reject visible defects despite passing averages.

photo.preprocessing: Caller-owned RGB conversion and aspect-preserving Lanczos fit

card.preprocessing: Caller-owned RGB conversion and aspect-preserving Lanczos fit

chart.preprocessing: Unchanged previously reviewed diagnostic chart; encoder performs its specified integer grayscale conversion
